questions.knowledge_point: Multiplying a 2x2 Matrix by a Column Vector
questions.worked_solution:
We multiply each row in the matrix by the column vector using the dot product. Multiplying the first row, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}[\begin{aligned}2 & 1 \\ 5 & -3\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}5 \\ 4\end{aligned}] & =[\begin{aligned}2\cdot 5+1\cdot 4 \\ ∗\end{aligned}]=[\begin{aligned}14 \\ ∗\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$

Multiplying the second row, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}[\begin{aligned}2 & 1 \\ 5 & -3\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}5 \\ 4\end{aligned}] & =[\begin{aligned}14 \\ 5\cdot 5+(-3)\cdot 4\end{aligned}]=[\begin{aligned}14 \\ 13\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, 

$$
[\begin{aligned}2 & 1 \\ 5 & -3\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}5 \\ 4\end{aligned}]=[\begin{aligned}14 \\ 13\end{aligned}].
$$
